propositions: LLMConfig lacks a headers field and from_env resolution mechanism to allow operators behind gateways to attach custom request headers
Raw header dicts are unsafe because vendor SDKs merge caller headers last, allowing a supplied Authorization to silently displace the real credential
The three-layer precedence (CLI > environment variable > TOML file) must resolve headers with hard errors on malformed JSON and invalid placeholders instead of silent degradation
Placeholder grammar with ${env:VAR}, ${run:KEY}, and $$ escape must be validated at config-resolution time to prevent injection via environment variable indirection

Header names and values must be validated by a denylist (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization, and RFC 7230 violations) and reject CR/LF/NUL to prevent credential displacement and protocol injection
